reviews.notes: Clause-by-clause vs locked Greek 2026-09-17. C1: kai Petron kai tous allous apostolous apodechometha hos Christon -> receive both Peter and the other apostles as we receive Christ; pseudepigrapha -> falsely inscribed; hos empeiroi paraitoumetha + ginoskontes hoti ou parelabomen -> we refuse as those who know the tradition, knowing that we did not receive (negation kept; tradition compresses empeiroi+paralambano, faithful). C2: me dielthon -> without going through; hypenoon -> supposed; anaginoskestho -> let it be read (3sg imp); mikropsychian -> small-souledness. C3: mathon...spoudaso -> having learned...I will hurry (fut); prosdokate me en tachei -> expect me soon. C4: hopoias en haireseos ho Markianos -> what sort of heresy Marcianus belonged to; heauto enantioo -> opposed himself; me noon ha elalei -> not understanding what he was saying; mathesesthe -> you will learn (2pl fut). C5: diadochon -> successors; Doketas -> Docetae; ta men pleiona...tina de prosdiestalmena -> most...but some things inserted besides (men...de kept); hypetaxamen -> we have appended. Scripture: apodechometha hos Christon echoes Gal 4:14 edexasthe me hos Christon Iesoun (same verb root + hos+Christon); filed clear upheld; Jev advisory said possible at 0.53 (uncertain) and is overruled by the wording parallel; DOCX builder injects the cite inline beside the clause, english[] stays clean per lane shape. Pass A!=B: serapion_1.json gloss is hyphenated literal gloss, distinct from reading English. OCR note: DjVu prints katelabomen (Vet.Interp.) for katalabomenoi - apparatus variant, no meaning change.
